## Scope

This audit reviewed 377 second reads completed during the quarter. The review focused on the consistency between the first and second grades recorded for each set. The audit provides a summary of the level of agreement observed across the reviewed reads and supports routine quality monitoring. The findings are intended to identify the overall result for the quarter and provide a basis for follow-up where required.

## Result

The first and second grades agreed in 73.5 per cent of sets reviewed. This is the overall agreement result for the audit period. Per-grader results are provided in the attached spreadsheet. These results will be discussed privately with each grader as part of the usual review process. The overall result and the individual results should be considered together when reviewing grading quality and identifying any areas requiring attention.
